name: o28203

schema.description: A request for Order status information.

buyerId.description: The ID of the Service Provider (Buyer) organization placing the order.

buyerPurchaseOrderNumber.description: A number that uniquely identifies a order within the buyer's enterprise.

objectType.description: The type of the object, orderStatusRequest.

orderId.description: Unique identifier for the order for which status information is being requested (if known, otherwise the buyerPurchaseOrderNumber is reauired).

sellerId.description: The ID of the Partner/Access Provider (Seller) organization receiving the order.

schema.title: orderStatusRequest

description:
Subject: Request for Order Status – ORD-20230615-ABCDEF1234567890  

Dear SELLER98765 Team,

We would like to inquire about the current status of our order identified by orderId **ORD-20230615-ABCDEF1234567890**. This request is being submitted by our organization, BUYER12345, under the purchase order number **PO20230615001**. Please treat this as an **orderStatusRequest** and provide any available updates at your earliest convenience.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.
